results.title: Where the most new millionaires emerged in 2025
results.description: Nearly one million people crossed the $1 million wealth threshold in 2025, averaging more than 2,680 each day. The United States accounted for almost half of them worldwide, with over 1,200 reaching the milestone daily, bringing the total number of millionaires in the country to more than 23.6 million. results.title: Awalé closes strategic investment for Côte d'Ivoire exploration project
results.description: TSX-V-listed Awalé Resources has finalised its private placement financing agreement with gold production and development company Predictive Discovery and mid-tier precious metals producer Fortuna Mining, securing funds that will mainly go toward exploration at its wholly-owned Odienné project, in Côte d'Ivoire. Awalé has issued about 16-million common shares to Predictive Discovery for gross proceeds of $14-million, representing about 11.8% of the company’s issued and outstanding common shares.
